audit.summary: Proposition2.1.1(1)'s equivalence fails for arbitrary locally closed G-stable Z. A smooth affine Hamiltonian SL2 plane with Z={0} satisfies(c), but the restricted zero fiber is a point and not Lagrangian. Full Borel level remains a Lagrangian line.
